remarks: In the heart of downtown Stamford! Renovated spacious & sunny 3rd floor unit. Large studio with a kitchen alcove with full size refrigerator, gas /oven range & dishwasher. Full bath with tub & closet & dressing. Heat, hot water and cooking gas included. Laundry and storage in basement. Tenant pays non-refundable credit/application fee, electricity and liability and renter's insurance. Convenient to all major routes and amenities ~ near to shops, restaurants, theaters, bus line, etc. Freshly painted ~ Spacious, sun-filled light and bright ~ move in, unpack and enjoy the vibes of City life!
